rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose legal term for the right or authority to apply the law or exercise control.

example.english: The local court has jurisdiction to hear this case.
example.traditional: 本地法院有管轄權審理呢宗案件。
example.jyutping: bun2 dei6 faat3 jyun2 jau5 gun2 hat6 kyun4 sam2 lei5 ne1 zung1 on3 gin2

rows.note: Use this everyday term when the focus is on whether a person or organization has the power or authorization to act.

example.english: I don't have the jurisdiction to approve this application.
example.traditional: 我冇權限批准呢項申請。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 kyun4 haan6 pai1 zeon2 ne1 hong6 san1 cing2

rows.note: Use this when jurisdiction means the territory or limits within which an authority can act.

example.english: This area is outside the court's jurisdiction.
example.traditional: 呢個地區唔喺本港法院嘅管轄範圍之內。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 m4 hai2 bun2 gong2 faat3 jyun2 ge3 gun2 hat6 faan6 wai4 zi1 noi6
